title: Mahi Harbor Cruises & Private Events

services.name: Mahi Cruises
services.desc: We love being a part of your special moments. whether you’re throwing a wedding with 150 people or a company party of 10. We believe everything is worth celebrating. This summer, celebrate with us. At Mahi, we specialize in boat parties that cater to all your needs. We have everything needed to create an amazing experience for you and your guests. Customize everything from the food, cruise length, route, boat, and music. Looking for a unique transportation option to get your guests from point A to point B? We can do that too! The possibilities are endless. This iconic boat has been a staple of the community for more than five decades. With two spacious decks and a capacity of up to 150
